description: This file contains utility functions and declarations for RPC (Remote Procedure Call) handling in PyTorch's distributed RPC framework, including serialization/deserialization, error handling, and tensor management.

methods.name: getRPCErrorType
methods.description: Parses an error message and returns the corresponding RPCErrorType.

methods.name: makeRPCError
methods.description: Creates an error string based on the provided error description and type.

methods.name: deserializeRequest
methods.description: Deserializes an RPC request message into an RpcCommandBase object.

methods.name: deserializeResponse
methods.description: Deserializes an RPC response message into an RpcCommandBase object and sets the message type.

methods.name: deserializeResptoIValueInternal
methods.description: Deserializes an RPC response into an IValue, attaching backward functions if needed.

methods.name: deserializeRespToIValue
methods.description: Converts a response message into an IValue.

methods.name: wireSerialize
methods.description: Serializes payload and tensors into a wire format.

methods.name: wireDeserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data into payload and tensors.

methods.name: cloneSparseTensors
methods.description: Clones tensors that are views to reduce network traffic.

methods.name: writeWrappedPayload
methods.description: Combines original and additional payloads for wrapped RPC.

methods.name: readWrappedPayload
methods.description: Extracts the original payload from a wrapped RPC payload.

methods.name: populateRemoteProfiledEvents
methods.description: Populates autograd profiler events for RPC.
